name: Filter Bar
summary: Global filter bar — searchable multi-select dropdowns, dual-thumb range sliders, search and toggles — with an active-filter chip row that also shows chart cross-filter selections.
summary_zh: 全局筛选栏：可搜索的多选下拉框、双滑块区间、文本搜索和开关，并以标签行汇总当前筛选（包括图表点击产生的交叉筛选）。
description_zh: 放在页面顶部或固定顶栏（.rk-topbar__controls）中，为整份报告设置全局筛选：所有绑定了包含该字段的数据集的图表都会同步刷新。每个筛选器从 data 指定的数据集读取取值或数值范围；多选下拉框支持搜索、全选 / 仅选此项，并显示在其他筛选条件下的计数；区间滑块显示格式化的上下限和分布条，支持数值与日期字段。下方标签行列出所有生效的筛选（含图表交叉筛选，虚线标签），可逐个移除或一键“Reset all”；右侧显示筛选后的行数。放在顶栏（紧凑单行布局）时，图表点击产生的选择同样以可移除的虚线标签显示在同一行，放不下的收进“+N”弹出框，顶栏始终保持一行高。界面文字随报告语言（RK.i18n，en / zh-CN）切换。适合同业可比、先例交易、地区 / 行业切片等需要客户自助切换口径的页面。
best_for: Precedent transaction screens (date range, sector, consideration)
Sticky top-bar global filters for a whole report
Making chart cross-filter selections visible and removable
avoid_when: Filters that should only affect one chart (use that chart's own options.where)

filters.desc: [{field, type: 'select'|'multi'|'range'|'search'|'toggle', label, data, values, default, format, key, datasets, step, min, max, placeholder, value, expr, searchable, allLabel, sort}] — data = dataset id for values / extent (default: the block's dataset); key = store filter key (default: field); datasets = restrict the filter to these dataset ids; toggle applies {field in [value]} or an expression filter (expr)

layout.desc: auto | stacked | inline (auto = inline pills inside .rk-topbar, stacked with labels elsewhere)

chips.desc: Active-filter chips with per-chip ×: stacked layout = a chip row for own filters and chart selections plus 'Reset all'; inline / top-bar layout = chart selections as chips on the same line (own filters show in their pills), the ones that do not fit collapse into a '+N' popover so the bar stays one line high

crossFilters.desc: Show chart cross-filter selections (store filters with a source) as dashed chips (both layouts)

count.desc: '12 of 18 companies' readout for the bound dataset

histogram.desc: Distribution strip above range sliders (counts respect the other filters)

interactions: Searchable multi-select with select all / 'only' / reset and live facet counts
Dual-thumb range slider: drag, click the track, arrow / PageUp / Home / End keys
Chips for own filters and chart cross-filters with × and 'Reset all'
Top bar: chart selections as removable chips on the same line; overflow in a '+N' popover with 'Clear chart selections'
Stays in sync with RK.store (other bars, charts, resets)
Keyboard: listbox, slider and switch ARIA patterns; Esc closes popovers
